response.sql: SELECT t.transreg AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(s.shortintrt) / g.grp_avg AS short_interest_ratio FROM transactionrecord t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN (SELECT t2.ordertypedist AS otd, AVG(s2.shortintrt) AS grp_avg FROM transactionrecord t2 JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s2 ON s2.transref = t2.transreg GROUP BY t2.ordertypedist) g ON g.otd = t.ordertypedist GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, g.grp_avg ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
